page.notes: Hebrew is printed in a heavy, blurred font with heavy show-through and speckle; many vowel points and consonants are uncertain and are marked [?]. The Hebrew of the first line of the left column and the Hebrew before "in ventriculo" are not legible with confidence. The Latin "netum" is doubtful (could be "metum"). The Rad. entry after "(Rad. ined. gem.)" is illegible. Some Hebrew forms in the mactatio, perversum and mundandus entries were reconstructed from the Latin glosses and should be checked against the scan. The catchword "Rad." and the signature "H h" are placed as printed at the foot. The "מ ט" line in the left column is a bare letter pair printed as a section marker and is kept as a line.
